Ms. Tanja from Energu raised this ticket due to a OCPP failure. In the Router WebUI we can see that it mentions “SIM Failure”. After checking with Semih, it seems the problem either lies on the SIM Card or the Router, most likely the SIM as we've never faced this error before.
